headline: California's For-Profit Utilities Bankroll "Wildfire Victims First" Front Group to Push Utility Bailout, Says Consumer Watchdog
summary: Consumer Watchdog today released a new analysis exposing "Wildfire Victims First" as a utility-funded political front group created to manufacture support for a utility bailout that would weaken accountability when California's investor-owned utilities spark catastrophic wildfires.
